g.text: Difference = new nested learner minus comparator, using matching scenario IDs and original outer folds.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242b32

g.text: Each comparator retains all 120 paired identities. Only the new-auto / comparator-available intersection is scored.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: For the legacy learner, n is common automatic service. For each reference, n means common financial evaluability; references are hypothetical.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #242b32

g.text: New Q1 products, static screens and dynamic calibration may all differ; these are complete-procedure contrasts, not a pure execution ablation.

g.text: Read these conditional outcomes together with coverage, selected-beta stability and Review reasons. No winner is selected.
